response.overview: It's a peaceful day on the Island of Sodor, until things go horribly wrong, Emily has accused Thomas of being a bad boyfriend even though she doesn't know the full story of Diesel 10's devious trick. Meanwhile a familiar face shows up to bring joy to our Favorite Number 1. Can she be able to help or will Diesel 10 finally win his vengeance?
response.title: Thomas’ Heartbreak: The Movie
